assertions.name: CLI help exposes --replication
assertions.detail:
Version: 1.1.0

Usage: tc [options] [command]

TinyCloud CLI — self-sovereign storage from the terminal

Options:
  -V, --version         output the version number
  -p, --profile <name>  Profile to use
  -H, --host <url>      TinyCloud node URL
  -v, --verbose         Enable verbose output
  --no-cache            Disable caching
  -q, --quiet           Suppress non-essential output
  --json                Force JSON output
  --replication         Enable read-through replication for this invocation
  --no-replication      Disable read-through replication for this invocation
  --replication-debug   Write replication diagnostics to stderr
  -h, --help            display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]        Initialize a new TinyCloud profile
  context [options]     Report selected identity, host, space and local session
                        state as JSON (does not test access)
  auth                  Authentication management
  enable                Enable a narrowly scoped TinyCloud service
  kv                    Key-value store operations
  replica               Durable read-only local replicas of a KV prefix (sync
                        online, read offline) [beta]
  space                 Space management
  delegation            Manage delegations
  share                 Publish and consume TinyCloud Share links
  node                  Node health and info
  profile               Profile management
  completion            Generate shell completions
  vault                 Encrypted vault operations
  secrets               Encrypted secrets management
  vars                  Plaintext variable management
  doctor                Run diagnostic checks
  sql                   SQLite database operations for your TinyCloud space
  duckdb                DuckDB database operations
  manifest              Inspect TinyCloud app manifests
  upgrade               Upgrade the TinyCloud CLI to the latest version
  status                Show local TinyCloud profile, session, delegation, and
                        permission state
  account               Account applications, spaces, delegations, and billing
  help [command]        display help for command
